generations.prompt: Draft Amazon KDP back-cover blurb and BISAC categories for The Lantern Bear and the Firefly Brook.
generations.outputText:
When twilight settles over Whispering Pine Valley, Barnaby the young bear sets off along the mossy brook with his glowing brass lantern. Alongside a clever red fox and a fleet of folded paper boats, Barnaby discovers that even the smallest light can guide a friend home.

Recommended KDP Categories:
• Juvenile Fiction / Bedtime & Dreams
• Juvenile Fiction / Animals / Bears
• Juvenile Fiction / Nature & the Natural World
